title: The Statement of Applicability view and J-10 end to end

acceptance: SoA view: reference, title, applicability, reason, status, who, when, per-unit history; REG-S13, S14, S15 and REG-S16 (J-10 @smoke) un-fixmed: scope add with step-up, certificate on the entity, 'Applies' with 'Certified', paste of three units confirmed in one call, the SoA view, the next audit on the roadmap; seed extended only if needed.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md and CLAUDE.md section 11; clocks anchored. The roadmap's internal-row rendering lands in c8-ui-home-register in this wave; write the step against the card's text.

brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md and CLAUDE.md section 11. Fill the stub sections; do not edit OrganisationScreen.tsx.

title: Case deadlines, actions and recurring duties on the roadmap, periods kept until they end, and a standard counted once on Today

acceptance: 'Our deadline' with owner for an open case's internal deadline, a live open action's due date and a duty occurrence (dropped when completed); cases.read and scope respected; none reaches the calendar feed (test per branch); a quarter-precision date stays until its quarter ends; REG-S10's roadmap line completed; REG-S15's 'Today counts the standard as one obligation' line added to test_reg_s15; HOM-03 built with its note rewritten.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, D-52, H22. The standing count itself is c8-home-standing-roadmap's; you only assert it in REG-S15.

brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, D-25, D-97, H15, D-78. Any confirmed link counts, a person's or an independent agent's (D-97, default pending Alex).

acceptance: DIGEST_SEND_HOUR on digest_weekday per tenant; test_col_s2 un-skipped (sv reminder, escalation to head and compliance officer, digest per language matching My work); COL-S3 and COL-S11 green; fan-out logs counts only; COL-S2 seed anchored (action due in three days and one overdue owned by the Swedish member, muted-mentions member, absent member with delegate, last week's digest row) and journey un-fixmed with the Swedish digest in the E2E outbox; COL-S1 journey un-fixmed; COL-02 built.

acceptance: Each control refuses a platform agent via refuse_platform_agent and writes record(); B gets 404; a guard walks every tenant agent route and fails on one not calling the fence; a runner event whose cumulative cost passes the cap interrupts and pauses; AGT-S5 and AGT-S6 un-skipped and their journeys un-fixmed (above_plan_limit and feature_off declared; no spend figure includes a platform run); AGT-04 built.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md and CLAUDE.md section 11.

acceptance: run_now, check_source, check_url (https only, no private, loopback or redirect-to-private address, no STANDARDS_PUBLISHER_HOSTS, fetched body screened and stored as data) and research_topic (library or taxonomy keys only until Alex answers the tenant-text question) each open a run with trigger request and are jobs; platform agent 403; no own agent 409 no_tenant_agent; RESEARCH_REQUESTS_PER_MONTH 429; at cap 422 budget_cap_reached; request text never logged and never reaches a model; B 404; console re-tag (tenant NULL) opens a platform run and files its batch through batch.create_batch(); a tenant session 403; AGT-S7 reworded to agents.manage and un-skipped, journey un-fixmed; AGT-05 cell.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, D-07, D-32 and CLAUDE.md section 11.

acceptance: Entry scope a second predicate on every list and detail; out of scope answers the same 404 another tenant gets; footprint=all and watched 422 for these principals; owned records and the overlay never returned without the gate; stable-key lookup for get_obligation; POST /search accepts search:read narrowed in hybrid.py; /upcoming narrowed and library-only; search_eval.py run; ACC-S1 un-skipped; ACC-01 cell.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, AGENT_ACCESS.md, D-10 (search stays library-only in R2 unless Alex says otherwise).

title: What applies: the deterministic list and what the entry could not see
goal: POST /agent-access/what-applies returns the in-scope list with its scope statement and names out-of-scope dimensions by label.
acceptance: Description required, length-capped by a setting, never stored or logged; list deterministic (in-scope obligations plus register entries when reach passes), ranked in memory from the library index, never truncated beyond pagination; own records left out with their count; scope statement (entry, departments, products, as-of) on every agent-access answer through one documented mechanism in the guard; summary slot 'not drafted'; out-of-scope compares against labels and usage notes of footprint terms outside scope with pg_trgm or token match, works with AI off, names labels never records, adds 'ask compliance'; ACC-S6 un-skipped; ACC-07 cell.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, AGENT_ACCESS.md, AC-ACC1.

title: Personal access tokens, and every key and token in one list
goal: Members with tokens.create mint tokens behind a step-up, and admins see and revoke every credential.
acceptance: POST /me/tokens (tokens.create + step-up; expiry required up to PERSONAL_TOKEN_MAX_DAYS; scopes within AGENT_ACCESS_SCOPES and backed by own permissions; optional entry; shown once, hashed), GET, DELETE (revoke); GET /tenant/api-keys and revoke widened to every key and token with kind and entry or person; events logged; ACC-S3 and ACC-S9 un-skipped; ACC-03 cell; documented. Unbound tenant keys stay library-only (agent-access default).
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, ADR 0056. A token can never step up or open a session; no password-like path exists.

acceptance: Entry list with scope summary; register and edit dialog with department, product and team pickers and step-up; revoke with confirm; entry page with credentials (issue with expiry behind step-up, shown once, revoke), reach toggle read-only with its reason while the tenant switch is off, access log paged; the Access tab on AgentsScreen; TenantReachPanel filled (request with step-up, pending banner naming the requester, approve with passkey, four-eyes refusal as a state, reject, switch off, read-only without security.manage); every state; unit tests.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md. Journeys are acc-summary-j11's and acc-fe-tokens'.

brief: Built under D-89 ('can not be agent managed'). Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md and SCOPE_ITEMS.md. Four eyes and the passkey stay exactly as FP-02 has them.
